title: Bring in ’Da Noise, Bring in ’Da Funk / Light tap poster

location.series: Pentagram / The Public Theater case study

slide_intent: Test contrast reversal because the same composition can change its visual weight without losing recognition.
strategic_value: A light-ground variant can extend the tap-sole campaign while retaining its central motif and red title accents.
demonstration: Black hand-lettered reviews radiate around a black tap sole on white; red edges accent NOISE and FUNK.
practical_value: Compare positive and negative versions of the same campaign treatment with PT14.

content_islands.name: Central object
content_islands.spec: Center the black sole on the white field.

content_islands.name: Text surround
content_islands.spec: Retain radial black reviews, red title edges and the bottom information band.
